intent: A row of filter chips with add, clear all, and an overflow menu when the row is too long.
useWhen: Several filters above a table or list
The person adds a filter, clears them all, or opens one chip
doNotUseWhen: Search inside a table — use DataTable

filters.note: Each item is { id, label, value?, count? }.

onClear.note: Clear all. Shown when a filter has a value or count.

maxVisible.note: Extra chips collapse into a +N menu.

requirements: The row is a group labelled Filters, or ariaLabel
Each chip is a kit FilterButton
Overflow is a menu of the hidden filters
Clear all is a button, present only when a filter is set

doNot: Do not invent a local chip — chips are FilterButton
Do not invent an overflow chip — overflow is kit DropdownMenu
